canonical_title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
description: The paper introduces QDA, a closed‑loop system where an LLM‑based agent iteratively proposes, builds, and evaluates post‑training quantization configurations for large language models. By running multiple refinement rounds, the agent automatically tailors quantization recipes to each model and precision, reducing the need for manual expert redesign.

canonical_title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
description: The paper proposes ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a memory architecture that lets enterprise LLM agents evolve their knowledge from observed failures. The memory updates autonomously using the agent model itself or a teacher model, without changing model weights, tools, or workflow logic.

canonical_title: A Hybrid RAG Framework for Deceptive Review Detection: Integrating RoBERTa-LoRA, FAISS-Based Retrieval, and LLM Reasoning
description: The authors present a Retrieval‑Augmented Generation framework that uses a LoRA‑adapted RoBERTa classifier, FAISS semantic vector search, and a large language model to reason about and label spam or deceptive online reviews. The system was evaluated on both balanced and heavily imbalanced real‑world review datasets.

canonical_title: Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips
description: Exa optimized its neural‑search embedding inference for AWS Neuron hardware (Inferentia2 and Trainium2) by adding custom NKI kernels, achieving roughly a 47% improvement in performance and cost per million documents, which translates to a 50% increase in overall embedding throughput for indexing billions of web documents.

canonical_title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
description: NVIDIA announced that RTX Spark compact desktop systems built by ASUS, Dell and MSI are now on sale. The machines run Windows, include up to 128 GB of unified memory and ship with NVIDIA's AI software stack, enabling local AI agents, image and video generation, and model fine‑tuning on the device.
